title: Codable: JSON in and out
hints: struct Todo: Codable, Equatable { let id: Int; let title: String; let isDone: Bool; enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey { case id, title, isDone = "is_done" } }
Decode: try JSONDecoder().decode([Todo].self, from: Data(json.utf8)).  Encode: try JSONEncoder().encode(todo).
